     datetime() - duration({

  topic: t.topic,

    right('0' + toString(dt.day),2) + '/' +
    right('0' + toString(dt.month),2) + '/' +
    toString(dt.year)
})

CREATE (author)-[:CREATED]->(p);

name: Generate users FOLLOWS relationship
query:
MATCH (u:User)
WITH collect(u) AS users

UNWIND users AS u
WITH u, users,
     [x IN users 
      WHERE x.user_id <> u.user_id 
        AND (u.user_id + x.user_id) % 5 = 0][0..5] AS targets

UNWIND targets AS t
MERGE (u)-[:FOLLOWS]->(t);

name: Generate LIKES relatioship User --> Post
query:
MATCH (p:Post)
WITH collect(p) AS posts, size(collect(p)) AS n

MATCH (u:User)
WITH u, posts, n

// generate candidate indices (small bounded set, not all posts)
WITH u, posts, n,
     [i IN range(0, 14) |  // only 15 candidates max → efficient
        posts[(u.user_id * 17 + i * 31) % n]
     ] AS candidates

UNWIND candidates AS p

// pseudo-random filter per (user, post)
WITH u, p,
     ( (u.user_id * 13 + p.post_id * 7) % 10 ) AS score

WHERE score < 3   // ~30% chance

// limit max 5 per user
WITH u, collect(p)[0..5] AS likedPosts

UNWIND likedPosts AS p
MERGE (u)-[:LIKES]->(p);

name: Create indexes on User and Post
query:
CREATE INDEX user_id_index FOR (u:User) ON (u.user_id);
CREATE INDEX post_id_index FOR (p:Post) ON (p.post_id);
